scope: Exploratory internal observational association with the recorded postoperative deficit category; no surgery causality, route effects, clinical deployment, or planner reward.

source.attribution: Cepeda et al. (2023), RHUH-GBM, TCIA; DOI 10.7937/4545-c905

cohort.no_posthoc_exclusion: Keep previously treated records and published eligibility/rounding discrepancies; source drift, missingness or schema inconsistency fails this protocol rather than changing cohort.

endpoint.name: any_recorded_postoperative_deficit
endpoint.assessment_time: postoperative per source; exact clinical assessment date/interval unknown
endpoint.severity_and_persistence_definition: not supplied; retain source categories only

preoperative_kps.assumption: Numeric KPS enters a linear log-odds term; this is not an interval harm scale.

predictors.availability: Source-labelled preoperative; exact measurement and availability timestamps unknown. Retrospective CSV is not proof of real-time availability.
examples_excluded: molecular and pathology data without established preoperative availability

comparators.probability: mean training-fold binary endpoint; no smoothing

validation.ordered_folds: one holdout for each ordered_patient_id; all other patients train

scaler.fit_scope: training fold only, independently for each model/fold/permutation/deletion

metrics.primary: paired mean Brier difference KPS_CE_VOLUME minus KPS; negative favors addition of CE volume
metrics.brier: mean((probability - binary_endpoint)**2) over all eligible held-out patients
secondary: ROC_AUC for the two logistic comparators
confusion counts TN FP FN TP at fixed threshold

null_rules.FOLD_PREVALENCE_ROC_AUC: null: per-LOO prevalence=(total positives - heldout y)/(n-1), creating inverse ordering of heldout labels; a pooled AUC would be an artifact, not useful discrimination.
null_rules.per_fold_ROC_AUC: null: one heldout patient per fold
null_rules.zero_denominator: null with explicit reason, never zero substituted
null_rules.confidence_intervals: not estimated: overlapping LOO fits and n=40 do not create independent fold observations
null_rules.clinical_calibration_validation: not established by reporting Brier; no calibration model fitted

metrics.raw_four_category_performance: descriptive category counts only; no severe/persistence-specific model claims

label_permutation_diagnostic.order: 99 successive permutations of original ordered 40-label vector; preserve each permutation index and label vector
label_permutation_diagnostic.rerun: all training-fold scaling, prevalence calculation and logistic fits under each permuted endpoint; same patient holdouts/features/configuration
label_permutation_diagnostic.interpretation: Finite Monte Carlo chance/leakage diagnostic under exchangeable labels. Destroys KPS association too; NOT a conditional test that volume adds information given KPS, and NOT a causal or external-validation result.
label_permutation_diagnostic.incomplete_rule: If any planned permutation fails or is unexecuted, p_value=null; retain all attempted values/failures and planned denominator99, never divide by completed count.

positive_deletion_influence.deleted_ids: all original endpoint-positive patients, in fixed lexicographic ID order
positive_deletion_influence.operation: remove one positive patient, rerun full39-patientLOO for all three comparators; each logistic trainingfold has38patients
outputs: paired KPS_CE_VOLUME minus KPS Brier difference
difference from observed full-cohort paired difference
positive_deletion_influence.summary: if all14 complete, range and sign counts of paired difference; otherwise summary=null with planned/completed/failed counts
positive_deletion_influence.interpretation: Descriptive sensitivity to individual event records; reduced evaluation cohorts differ. Not a confidence interval, extra patients, causal patient effects, or a reason to remove an inconvenient patient.

resources.worker_wall_scope: imports, parsing, all observed/permuted/influence fits, metrics and final writes
resources.deadline_semantics: cooperative checks before/after each fit plus parent hard stop after grace; preserve actual elapsed/overshoot and failure; no budget enlargement during run

failure_policy.invalid_inputs: fail before fitting on hash/schema/ID/count/missingness/nonfinite mismatch; never impute or drop silently
failure_policy.fit_failure: exception, nonfinite probabilities/coefficients, ConvergenceWarning or n_iter reaching1000 makes affected fold failed; preserve warning/error/model/fold identity
failure_policy.no_partial_observed_metrics: Require all40predictions per comparator for observed pooled metrics; no failures omitted from denominator
failure_policy.diagnostics: Preserve incomplete/failed diagnostic attempts; never treat them as successful completed diagnostics
failure_policy.publication: Only completed worker and launcher authorities with unchanged input/source/configuration and fit receipts authorize complete status; partial artifacts remain explicitly incomplete.

required_outputs: train/holdout ID lists or reversible fold specification
fold scaler means/scales, coefficients/intercepts, iterations and convergence status
all14 influence deletion identities/predictions/statistics and failures
model/phase fit counts and separate timings, peak RSS, cancellation/overshoot
all null metrics with reasons and planned/completed/failed denominators
prohibited-field shadow-input hash, projection equalities and same-fit prediction invariance receipts

required_before_execution: record Python/NumPy/SciPy/scikit-learn versions, platform, numerical backend and thread settings

limitations: 40 selected patients and14events; two major persistent records do not support a major-risk model
cohort selected for extensive resections, treatment and recurrence imaging; transportability limited
outcome timing/domains/baseline focal deficits and course definitions unknown
preoperative features are source-labelled with exact availability unknown
observational association under actual care only
no patient-specific clinical risk, surgical-route harm, planner reward, causal intervention, or external validation claim

adapter.source_digest: dataset.source.sha256 and record.source.sha256 bind the mixed source; never predictors
adapter.projection_semantic_hash: Only stable identity, allowed preoperative fields, schema and units; excludes full mixed CSV hash and postoperative values
adapter.label: record.any_recorded_postoperative_deficit
adapter.incomplete_input: null values fail fixed-cohort protocol before fitting; no missing-to-No conversion

prohibited_field_invariance.stage: after original source/schema validation and before fitting; predictions checked during observedLOO
prohibited_field_invariance.mutation: Sort rows by declared Patient ID. For every other column, set row i to the original value from row (i+1) modulo40; preserve protected columns and exact header names.
prohibited_field_invariance.derived_source: Serialize as an explicitly derived shadow CSV, record new SHA256 and parse using that explicit expected digest. Never claim it has the original source SHA.
required_equalities: ordered patient IDs and raw target categories
ordered permitted feature arrays and binary endpoint
for each observed fold and comparator, exactly equal predicted probability on corresponding original/shadow heldout features using the SAME fitted scaler/model or training-fold prevalence
prohibited_field_invariance.failure: Any mismatch fails before metrics publication. Preserve derived input hash and comparison receipt.
prohibited_field_invariance.scope: Negative control for use of forbidden columns through this adapter/projection and prediction path; not proof against every possible leakage mechanism.
